item.title: Bulletin updated at 05:50 HKT 22/Jul/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the dominance of the subtropical ridge, the fine spell and very hot weather will persist over southern China for the rest of this week and next week.

Date/Month: 22/07 (Friday)
Wind: Light winds force 2.
Weather: Sunny. Very hot during the day.
Temp range: 28 - 35 C
R.H. range: 55 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
